reviews.outcome: The disjoint witness reservoirs, bounded attention tests and induction supply a construction source lead beyond the Marks outline. Adapt it explicitly to the existing bounded oracle evaluator: compute an actual query bound, protect every query below that bound, and use a separate acted flag so zero restraint cannot mean both unacted and acted. Initialization/reset, fresh witness choices, fair consideration and eventual query agreement must be proved for the chosen construction. No new confirmed source defect in the selected argument under its intended step/use conventions; no later density/splitting assertions adopted.
